provider.name: Tardis
provider.free_sample_rule: first day of each month is available without an API key

frozen_reconstruction_rules: preserve source row order and both provider event timestamp and local capture timestamp
group exchange message rows by identical local_timestamp
skip non-snapshot rows before the first initial snapshot
when a new snapshot begins discard all prior book levels before applying snapshot rows
amount is an absolute level amount; zero removes the level
reject mixed snapshot/incremental rows inside one local_timestamp message
reject crossed reconstructed books for execution qualification
do not carry a pre-reset state through a following snapshot/restart boundary
do not nearest-neighbor join a target crossing to non-overlapping depth

cotemporal_rule.name: CROSSING_EXECUTION_INTERVAL_INTERSECTION_V1
cotemporal_rule.exact_instant: crossing event timestamp and local capture timestamp both equal the reconstructed-state message clocks
cotemporal_rule.interval: both crossing clocks must fall inside the same gap-free reconstructed-state support interval
cotemporal_rule.restart_boundary: a following snapshot prevents the preceding state from claiming an interval through the restart

acceptance_before_provider_pass: deterministic parser and book reconstruction pass synthetic RED-to-GREEN tests
snapshot reset and pre-snapshot buffering semantics are regression locked
co-temporal support rejects borrowing depth across reset boundaries
bid-side full-quantity target-or-better VWAP is deterministic
real free sample bytes are subsequently fetched from the frozen provider URL and hashed
the real sample parses/reconstructs under the exact frozen schema without manual edits
provider-sample PASS remains adapter feasibility only and cannot label historical events
next_action_after_provider_pass: Use the verified provider adapter to cost exact event-date historical L2 acquisition for the frozen #519 tradability consumer; request explicit approval before any paid data purchase. Historical cases without authenticated event-date L2 remain UNKNOWN_TRADABILITY.
